# Player at c8-11, need to wrap around again to consume another O block
# First, let me check M block position and other key objects

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find M block
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"M block: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Find pink center (lower creature)
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'P':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Pink center: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Find orange center (upper creature)
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O' and n['pixels'] >= 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        if min(rows) > 5:  # Not top bar
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            print(f"Orange center: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

pb = player['boundary']
pcols = [p[1] for p in pb]
print(f"\nPlayer after 20x RIGHT: c{min(pcols)}-{max(pcols)}")

# Check top bar O blocks
top_O = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O' and max([p[0] for p in n['boundary']]) <= 3]
print(f"Top O blocks: {len(top_O)}")
for n in top_O:
    b = n['boundary']
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
